children: Zeo ScientifiX announced its inaugural ZEO Xperience, a three-day regenerative medicine education event Oct 23–25 in Fort Lauderdale.
Announced multidisciplinary faculty and guest speakers for ZEO Xperience Oct 23–25 at Pier Sixty-Six Resort + Marina.
Event includes classroom education and hands-on clinical training on Oct 24 across aesthetics, orthopedics, intimate health, and plastic surgery.
Program covers science, biologics manufacturing, regulatory landscape, clinical best practices and practice implementation.
Attendance intentionally limited; registration open with full-event and single-day options.
